correctness.rationale: Reran inputs/artifacts minres/verify logic: S1 Betti [1,1,0], S0 [2,2,0]; closed-form matrices satisfy d^2=0 with ker==im dimensions (S1 3=3,0; S0 2=2,3=3,0) plus K1==imB2 and B2B3=0 giving subspace equality. Monomial checks ker(.b)=span{c,cb,cba}, ker(a,c)=span{(b,0),(ba,0)} hold. Degree shifts s2=d,s3=1 and t's make all maps degree 0 for every integer d, so graded gldim<=3 with pd 2,3 minimal. Bipartite parity proof gives no forbidden cycles hence smooth; dim 8 proper. Hence per=D^b(grmod_fd) and canonical t-structure restricts bounded with finite-length infinite-simples heart; charge Z=i,1+i has Im>0, injective hence support, and length heart gives HN. No gap between proof and computation.

originality.rationale: Terminal paid search returned a decisive prior covering the stability half of the headline: the EMS Oberwolfach record states Stab(per(A))=empty for exactly the Corollary 3 algebras with relations {ab,bc} and |a|+|b|=|b|+|c|=1, citing Haiden-Wu arXiv:2502.12075. Fetched Haiden-Wu body proves Theorem 4.5/Corollary 1.3 that the standard-grading one-boundary one-stop genus-1 Fukaya category admits no stability condition. This substantively implies the submitted nonempty-stability claim is not original (and on the cited evidence, false as stated).

value.rationale: TARGET route: both conditionals of the admitted target are resolved. The object (smooth-proper silting-free graded gentle algebra / torus with one boundary one stop zero winding) and invariants (bounded t-structure existence, Stab emptiness) were motivated before computation and explicitly posed as open in JSW 2025. Rigorously established graded gldim<=3 with minimal resolutions and an explicit HN+support stability condition is an exact, retrievable fact a future researcher on Fukaya stability, silting, or gentle global dimension could need. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
